changes.title: [CHANGE] Reject empty strings in `namespaceDiscovery.names`, `consulSDConfig.services`, and `consulSDConfig.tags` list fields in the `ScrapeConfig` CRD
changes.detail: [CHANGE] Reject empty strings in `namespaceDiscovery.names`, `consulSDConfig.services`, and `consulSDConfig.tags` list fields in the `ScrapeConfig` CRD. #8786

changes.title: [CHANGE] Update the default Alertmanager version to v0.34.0 and discard zero-value duration fields (`retention`, `clusterGossipInterval`…
changes.detail: [CHANGE] Update the default Alertmanager version to v0.34.0 and discard zero-value duration fields (`retention`, `clusterGossipInterval`, `clusterPushpullInterval`, `clusterPeerTimeout`) in `Alertmanager` resources instead of passing them as CLI flags, which Alertmanager rejects and can cause startup failures. Ignored fields are reported via the `IgnoredFields` status condition. #8800

changes.title: From 90.x to 91.x: This version upgrades Prometheus-Operator to v0.94.0 The operator's ClusterRole no longer grants wildcard verbs, following the tightened…
changes.detail: From 90.x to 91.x: This version upgrades Prometheus-Operator to v0.94.0 The operator's ClusterRole no longer grants wildcard verbs, following the tightened RBAC shipped upstream in v0.94.0. Since 68.4.0 it is also possible to use `crds.upgradeJob.enabled` for upgrading the CRDs. For traditional upgrades, please run these commands to update the CRDs before applying the upgrade.

changes.title: [kube-prometheus-stack] Bump prometheus-operator to v0.94.0 by @DrFaust92 in https://github.com/prometheus-community/helm-charts/pull/7269
[ENHANCEMENT] Support `webhook_url_file` for Discord receiver in Alertmanager configuration Secret (requires Alertmanager >= v0.28.0)
changes.detail: [ENHANCEMENT] Support `webhook_url_file` for Discord receiver in Alertmanager configuration Secret (requires Alertmanager >= v0.28.0). #8035

changes.title: [ENHANCEMENT] Tighten the operator's ClusterRole by replacing wildcard verbs with explicit permissions per resource
changes.detail: [ENHANCEMENT] Tighten the operator's ClusterRole by replacing wildcard verbs with explicit permissions per resource. #8752

changes.title: [FEATURE] Add `clusterPeerName` field to `Alertmanager` CRD to override the `--cluster.peer-name` flag (requires Alertmanager >= v0.30.0)
changes.detail: [FEATURE] Add `clusterPeerName` field to `Alertmanager` CRD to override the `--cluster.peer-name` flag (requires Alertmanager >= v0.30.0). #8767

changes.title: [FEATURE] Add `retentionPercentage` field to `Prometheus` and `PrometheusAgent` CRDs for volume-based retention (requires Prometheus >= v3.11.0)
changes.detail: [FEATURE] Add `retentionPercentage` field to `Prometheus` and `PrometheusAgent` CRDs for volume-based retention (requires Prometheus >= v3.11.0). Setting only the percentage no longer falls back to the default 24h time-based retention. #8728

changes.title: [FEATURE] Expose status conditions as Prometheus metrics for `Prometheus`, `PrometheusAgent`, `Alertmanager`, and `ThanosRuler` resources…
changes.detail: [FEATURE] Expose status conditions as Prometheus metrics for `Prometheus`, `PrometheusAgent`, `Alertmanager`, and `ThanosRuler` resources (`prometheus_operator_<resource>_status_condition`). #8719

changes.title: [BUGFIX] Add URL validation for Mattermost receiver fields in Alertmanager configuration Secret
changes.detail: [BUGFIX] Add URL validation for Mattermost receiver fields in Alertmanager configuration Secret. #8225

changes.title: [BUGFIX] Fix `TracingConfig` fields in `Prometheus` CRD not being serialized due to invalid JSON struct tags
changes.detail: [BUGFIX] Fix `TracingConfig` fields in `Prometheus` CRD not being serialized due to invalid JSON struct tags. #8730

changes.title: [BUGFIX] Fix `externalId` version gating for Alertmanager SigV4 configuration to require version >= v0.34.0 (was incorrectly set to v0.33.0)
changes.detail: [BUGFIX] Fix `externalId` version gating for Alertmanager SigV4 configuration to require version >= v0.34.0 (was incorrectly set to v0.33.0). #8759

changes.title: [BUGFIX] Fix operator panic when `AlertmanagerConfig` Pushover receivers use `userKeyFile` or `tokenFile` instead of secret selectors
changes.detail: [BUGFIX] Fix operator panic when `AlertmanagerConfig` Pushover receivers use `userKeyFile` or `tokenFile` instead of secret selectors. #8775

changes.title: [BUGFIX] Fix operator panic when kubelet Service synchronization fails and the service is unavailable
changes.detail: [BUGFIX] Fix operator panic when kubelet Service synchronization fails and the service is unavailable. #8743

changes.title: [BUGFIX] Fix resources stuck during deletion when the informer misses the deletion timestamp update
changes.detail: [BUGFIX] Fix resources stuck during deletion when the informer misses the deletion timestamp update. #8727

changes.title: [BUGFIX] Require Thanos >= v0.42.0 for delayed compaction with object storage uploads, raised from v0.41.0
changes.detail: [BUGFIX] Require Thanos >= v0.42.0 for delayed compaction with object storage uploads, raised from v0.41.0. Thanos v0.41.0 mis-validates the delayed-compaction paths and the sidecar crash-loops; deployments pinned to v0.41.0 fall back to disabling local compaction. #8764
